shadowSentences: I love to read books every evening.
My favorite season is spring when flowers bloom.
Traveling to new places enriches my life greatly.
Cooking new recipes can be both fun and challenging.
I enjoy watching movies with my friends on weekends.
Hiking in the mountains is an amazing way to relax.
Listening to music helps me focus when studying.
Playing sports teaches teamwork and discipline in life.
Volunteering at local shelters can make a big difference.
Learning a new language opens doors to many cultures.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: What is your favorite travel destination and why?
Q2: What challenges do you face when planning a trip?
Q3: In your opinion, what makes a successful travel experience?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your regular exercise routine?
Q2: What obstacles do you encounter when trying to stay active?
Q3: How important do you think exercise is for overall health?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone starting to exercise?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: What do you typically eat for breakfast?
Q2: How do your eating habits change when you are busy?
Q3: What is your opinion on healthy eating versus convenience food?
Q4: What recommendations would you give to someone wanting to eat healthier?
